name: btn-hover-outline

frames.best_why: The inverted hover state is full black with a crisp white outline, white label and white chevrons.

tagline: A white pill inverts to black with white text and a double arrow on hover.
summary: A pill-shaped Know More link with a double chevron. At rest it is white with black text; on hover it flips to black with a white outline, white text and white chevrons.
appearance: A white rounded pill holding bold black Know More text and a black double chevron. Hovered, it becomes a black pill with a thin white border and all of its content turns white.
behaviour: Hovering flips the colours: the white fill darkens to black, a white border appears and the label and chevrons turn white. It is a quick colour change with no movement.
search_phrases: pill button inverts colors on hover
use_when: A clear secondary link is needed on a monochrome page and a hard colour inversion will read strongly.
avoid_when: The invert depends on a stark black-and-white pair, so it clashes with tinted or low-contrast themes.
customise: The label, chevron icon and black-and-white palette are hardcoded; it accepts no props.
weight_why: One link with a colour transition and a single icon.

a11y.note: It is a real link with visible text and a native focus ring, but the invert plays on hover only, never on focus.

issues: Frame 5 catches mid-transition grey on grey, where the label and arrow briefly lose contrast.
polish_why: Well executed and very legible, but it is a plain colour invert on a standard pill.
